criteria.must: A text box for entering a name is visible on the web page
A 'Say Hello' button is visible on the web page
Clicking the 'Say Hello' button triggers a request to the API with the entered name
The API returns a response containing 'Hello, <name>!' where <name> is the provided name
The API response is valid JSON
The API response contains a 'message' field
The greeting from the API response is displayed on the web page
Clicking the button with an empty text box results in a greeting of 'Hello, World!'
The API provides a single endpoint for greeting requests
API requests succeed without providing authentication credentials
